//0: PartyBot server text, English. Same keys and {variables} as zh.json; check with contrib/i18n/i18n.mjs.

default: I need to head over to {places} to {why}. Mind waiting a moment?
{leader}, I'm swinging by {places} to {why}—I'll be right back, alright?
trip.ask.frugal: I'm heading to {places} to {why}. Already budgeted for it—mind waiting?
trip.ask.spendthrift: Coin pouch is looking thin again... heading to {places} to {why}. Wait up?
trip.ask.chatty: Oh, by the way, I need to run over to {places} to {why}. Mind waiting a sec?
trip.ask.lazy: Ugh, another trip to {places} to {why}... mind waiting a bit?

errand.declined.lazy: Works for me—saves me the walk.

meet.ask.default: Finished up here. Where are you? Should I come find you or wait by {gate}?
meet.ask.chatty: All done! Still busy? Want me to come to you, or should I wait at {gate}?
meet.ask.quiet: Done. Come to you, or wait at {gate}?

meet.arrived.default: I'm at {gate}. Come find me whenever you're ready.
meet.arrived.lazy: Taking a breather at {gate}. No rush.

reward.ask.default: Which reward should I take for {quest}?
reward.ask.frugal: For {quest}, should I just take whatever sells best? Have a look.

classquest.ask.default: {leader}, I'm ready for my class trial, "{quest}". Could you come with me?
classquest.ask.chatty: {leader}, I heard "{quest}" teaches some real tricks! Mind coming along with me?
classquest.ask.lazy: That "{quest}" trial... looks rough alone. Mind lending a hand?

classquest.askgear: {leader}, there's a class quest, "{quest}", that awards a nice piece of gear. Have time to help?

classquest.accepted.default: Great! I've jotted the details down for you—just lead the way.

classquest.declined: Alright, maybe next time we're in town.

classquest.giveup.default: Fair enough, I'll figure something out later.
classquest.giveup.lazy: Guess it can wait. No hurry anyway.

classquest.dropped: I'll set that aside for now then.
classquest.step: That part's done—check your quest log for what's next.

classquest.thanks.default: All done! Couldn't have managed without you—thanks!
classquest.thanks.chatty: We did it! No way I'd have pulled that off alone—thank you!

classquest.selfdone.default: By the way, I finished "{quest}" on my own.
classquest.selfdone.lazy: Finally dragged myself through "{quest}" on my own.

supply.offer.default: {leader}, you're running low on {what}. Want me to conjure some?
supply.offer.chatty: {leader}, looks like you're nearly out of {what}! Want me to whip up a batch?

supply.offer.stone.default: {leader}, you don't have a Healthstone. Want me to make one for you?

supply.declined: Alright, just say the word if you need any.
supply.noroom: Your packs are full—make a little room and I'll hand it over.
supply.failed: Trade didn't go through. We can try again in a bit.

supply.askmage.default: {leader}, I'm running low on {what}. Could you conjure some?
supply.askmage.lazy: {leader}, out of {what}... mind conjuring a bit?

supply.askmage.many: {leader}, {names} are running low on {what}. Could you conjure some for us?

artisan.ask.default: {leader}, I'm ready for Artisan {skill}, but no one in the city teaches it. We'll need to visit {trainer}. Mind taking me? I'll cover the {gold} fee myself.
artisan.ask.chatty: {leader}, my {skill} has hit a wall! I heard {trainer} teaches Artisan rank—mind taking a trip out there? I've got the {gold} covered!
artisan.ask.quiet: Artisan {skill} requires {trainer}. {gold} fee. Can we go?
artisan.ask.frugal: {leader}, Artisan {skill} costs {gold}. I've saved up the coin—just need you to guide me to {trainer}.

artisan.accepted.default: Great! I marked the directions in your quest log—once we're close, I'll head over myself.

artisan.declined: Alright, next time we're in town then.

artisan.giveup.default: Alright, I'll find my way to {trainer} on my own sometime.
artisan.giveup.lazy: Guess it can wait. No rush anyway.

affinity.trade.early.default: {leader}, no need to give me that—I can manage on my own.
affinity.trade.early.frugal: {leader}, really, I couldn't take your things.

affinity.trade.notallowed.default: {leader}, I'll take coin, food and drink, gear upgrades, or bigger bags—nothing else for now.
affinity.trade.notallowed.chatty: {leader}, I don't really have a use for that! Coin, provisions, better gear, or bigger bags are plenty.
affinity.trade.notallowed.quiet: Only coin, provisions, gear upgrades, or bags.

affinity.unlock.trade.default: {leader}, if you find better gear, provisions, or bigger bags for me, feel free to trade them over.
affinity.unlock.trade.chatty: {leader}, from now on if you've got spare gear upgrades, food, or bigger bags, just hand them over!
affinity.unlock.trade.quiet: You can trade me gear, provisions, and bags now.

affinity.unlock.tradeany.default: {leader}, you can trade me anything you like—I'll hold onto it.
affinity.unlock.tradeany.quiet: You can hand me anything now.

affinity.unlock.bags.default: {leader}, feel free to manage my packs however you see fit.
affinity.unlock.bags.lazy: {leader}, you can sort my packs for me—I can't be bothered.

affinity.unlock.summon: {leader}, just say the word whenever you need a summon.
affinity.unlock.craft: {leader}, bring me the reagents and I'll craft whatever you need.
affinity.unlock.portal: {leader}, let me know whenever you need a portal back to a city.

affinity.unlock.money.default: {leader}, if you're ever short on coin, take what you need from me.
affinity.unlock.money.frugal: {leader}, you can dip into my coin if you need it—just spend it wisely.

affinity.unlock.rewards: {leader}, you've got a better eye for quest rewards than I do—pick for me from now on.
affinity.unlock.account: {leader}, I want to stay by your side for good.

account.offer.default: {leader}, there's something I wanted to talk to you about.

account.offer.page.default: After everything we've been through together, I want to put my name in your roster for good. Whether you want to step into my boots yourself or call me to your side anytime, I'm yours to command. What do you say?
account.offer.page.chatty: {leader}, I've been thinking about this for a while! Put me in your roster—whether you want to play as me yourself or summon me to fight alongside you, I'm in. What do you think?
account.offer.page.quiet: ...Put my name in your roster. Will you?

account.join.done.default: Glad to hear it! I'm officially part of your roster now.
account.join.done.chatty: Awesome! I'm part of your roster now—let's make the most of it!

account.name.page.default:
{leader}, from now on I'm more than someone walking behind you. You can wear my armor and see this land through my eyes. I'll be another you.

Where I come from there's an old custom: when you give the rest of your days to someone, you ask them to call you by a name of their choosing. The old name stays with the road you walked alone; the new one belongs to the road ahead with them.

Will you give me a name? Or... shall I stay {me}?
account.name.page.chatty:
{leader}! I'm about to be part of your roster, and that deserves a proper ceremony!

Back home, whoever you trust with the rest of your life gets to name you. The old {me} walked here on his own; the new me walks with you.

Go on, give me a name! Or keep {me}, I like it too.
account.name.page.quiet:
From now on, I'm another you.

Where I'm from, the one you give your life to names you.

Name me. Or keep {me}.

account.name.new: Let me give you a name.

account.name.listen.default: (He goes down on one knee, head bowed, and waits for you to speak.)
account.name.listen.chatty: (He drops to one knee and grins up at you.) Go on, I'm ready!

account.join.named.default: {me}... {me}. From today {old} stays on the road behind us. The one at your side is {me}.
account.join.named.chatty: {me}! Great name, I love it! {old} is history, call me {me} from now on!

account.join.kept.default: {me} it is, then. Same name, but from today it's a name in your roster.
account.join.kept.chatty: Still {me}! Guess you got used to it. Your roster's own {me} from now on!

account.join.full: Your roster is full... free up a spot and call on me again. I'll wait.

account.later.default: No problem. Let me know through the Companions panel whenever you're ready.

affinity.trait.life.default: {leader}, traveling with you has taught me a few tricks of my own. ({trait})
affinity.trait.life.chatty: {leader}, spending all this time with you has really rubbed off on me—notice anything? ({trait})
affinity.trait.life.quiet: Picked up a habit traveling with you. ({trait})
affinity.trait.life.homebody: {leader}, being out on the road with you so much made me less homesick. ({trait})

affinity.trait.combat.default: {leader}, after all the fights we've survived, I've sharpened up quite a bit. ({trait})
affinity.trait.combat.chatty: {leader}, after all those scrap-ups, I'm not the greenhorn I used to be! ({trait})
affinity.trait.combat.quiet: All those battles sharpened me up. ({trait})
affinity.trait.combat.lazy: {leader}, you've dragged me into so many fights I couldn't slack off if I tried. ({trait})

affinity.trait.gatherer: {leader}, after all this time together, I've got a much better knack for gathering.
affinity.trait.nightowl: {leader}, I'm at my sharpest at night—barely need a breather.
affinity.trait.laststand: {leader}, don't worry—I'm not going down that easily.

artisan.thanks.default: Learned Artisan {skill}! Thanks for bringing me out here!
artisan.thanks.chatty: Artisan {skill} learned! Never would've found this place without you—thanks!

artisan.selfdone: By the way, I went and learned Artisan {skill} on my own.

talk.hello.new.chatty: Ah, {leader}! Need something? Just say the word!

talk.hello.friend.chatty: What's on your mind, {leader}? Ready when you are!

talk.hello.close.chatty: {leader}! Was just thinking about our next move—what's up?

talk.hello.drink.default: Let me finish this drink... alright, what's up?

talk.hello.town.default: Good to be back in town. What do you need?
talk.hello.town.chatty: Lively in the city today! What's the plan?
talk.hello.town.homebody: Nothing beats being back inside city walls. {leader}, what's up?

talk.follow.ok.chatty: Let's go, let's go—my boots were starting to take root!

talk.interact.page.default: What would you like to see?
talk.interact.page.chatty: Sure, have a look! What do you want to see?

talk.party.page.default: What do you want us to do?

talk.stay.team: Alright, we'll wait here for you.

talk.bags.ok.frugal: Look all you want, just don't misplace anything.

talk.portal.where.chatty: Which city are we headed to? Name it!

talk.portal.ok.default: Hold on, opening the portal now.

talk.craft.ok.default: See what you need—just bring the reagents.
talk.craft.ok.crafty: Always itching to craft something—pick whatever you need!

craft.stop.nomats: Out of reagents—that's all I can make.
craft.stop.far: You walked too far away, so I stopped.
craft.stop.bagsfull: My packs are full—make some room first.
craft.stop.failed: Can't seem to make that—probably missing a tool, or I need an anvil or forge.
craft.stop.cooldown: Can't rush that recipe—needs a little time before the next one.

leave.ask.default: {leader}, heading out? Should we wait here for you?
leave.ask.chatty: Where are you off to, {leader}? Want us to wait right here until you're back?

summon.ask.default: {leader}, all done over there? Want a summon back?

summon.start: Opening the portal—{helpers}, give me a hand!

summon.arrived.chatty: You're back! We were waiting on you!

summon.nohelp: Nobody came to click the portal... maybe next time.
summon.no.notlearned: I haven't learned Ritual of Summoning yet.
summon.no.locked: Well... we're not quite that close yet.
summon.no.noshard: I'm out of Soul Shards—can't summon you.
summon.no.nohelpers: I need two party members beside me to complete the ritual.
summon.no.fighting: In the middle of a fight here—hold on!
summon.no.here: Can't open a summoning portal in here.
summon.no.near: You're right beside me—just walk over.

travel.start.default: I'm in {zone}—heading your way, about {minutes} min.
travel.start.chatty: {leader}! I'm over in {zone}, give me about {minutes} min and I'll be right there!

travel.start.fly.default: I'm in {zone}—taking a gryphon over, about {minutes} min.
travel.start.fly.lazy: In {zone}... I'll catch a flight path, around {minutes} min.

travel.start.sail.default: I'm in {zone}—have to catch a boat over, about {minutes} min.

travel.start.hearth.default: I'm in {zone}—hearthing to {home} first, then heading over. About {minutes} min.
travel.start.hearth.chatty: {leader}, I'm in {zone}! Hearthing back to {home} first, then I'll hurry over—about {minutes} min!

travel.sail.chatty: On the ship! Waves are pretty rough out here...

lead.back.default: You lead the party—I'll follow your lead.
lead.back.chatty: Whoa, don't put me in charge! {leader}, you're the one leading this outfit!

leave.bye.default: I'll head off then. Call on me anytime.
leave.bye.chatty: Off I go then! {leader}, holler whenever you've got trouble to stir up!

leave.bye.hearth.default: Heading back to {home}. Call on me whenever you need.
leave.bye.hearth.homebody: Good timing—heading back to {home} to put my feet up. Call if you need me.

home.bind.default: Bound my hearthstone to {home} as well.
home.bind.homebody: {home} seems cozy enough—I'll make it my home too.

hearth.along.chatty: Hearthing to {home}? Wait up, I'm coming with!

talk.opt.craft: Can you craft something for me?
talk.opt.craft.171: Can you brew some potions for me?
talk.opt.craft.164: Can you forge something for me?
talk.opt.craft.165: Can you craft some leatherwork for me?
talk.opt.craft.197: Can you stitch something for me?
talk.opt.craft.202: Can you tinker something for me?
talk.opt.craft.333: Can you make something for enchanting?
talk.opt.craft.129: Can you wrap some bandages for me?
talk.opt.craft.185: Can you cook something for me?
talk.opt.interact: Let me have a look at you.
talk.opt.portal: Can you open a portal for me?

errand.paid.default: Thanks! I'll go train right now.
errand.paid.frugal: Much obliged—I'll make every copper count.

training.money: Fee: key skills {important}, all {all}; I have {have}.

offline.skillup.default: Practiced my trade while we were apart: {gains} (spent {gold} on materials).
offline.skillup.crafty: Kept my hands busy while you were away: {gains} ({gold} in materials).
offline.skillup.frugal: Worked on my craft a bit: {gains}. Spent {gold}—counted every copper.
offline.skillup.spendthrift: Bought a few too many supplies... {gains}, spent {gold}.

offline.skillup.free.default: Did a little roaming while we were apart: {gains}.
offline.skillup.free.gatherer: Spent the last few days gathering out in the wilds: {gains}.

offline.broke.default: Coin's been tight lately—couldn't afford to train my craft.
offline.broke.spendthrift: Coin's... all gone. Didn't get any crafting done.

bench.leveled.default: Did some adventuring on my own while we were apart—I'm level {level} now.
bench.leveled.chatty: Didn't just sit around while you were away! Cleared plenty of camps and hit level {level}!

parcel.subject.chatty: Open this up when you get a chance!

lesson.remind.default: I can learn {lessons} now—remember to take me to a trainer next time we're in a city.
lesson.remind.chatty: Oh! I can learn {lessons} now—take me to a trainer next time we hit a city!
lesson.remind.quiet: Can learn {lessons}. Visit a trainer in town.

lesson.remind.again: Still haven't learned {lessons}—don't forget to swing by a trainer in town.

meet.hello.chatty: Hey there, traveler! What brings you over?

meet.invited.default: Hold on—why the sudden invite? Do I know you?
meet.invited.chatty: Whoa, what's the invite for? Say hello first!

meet.invite.far: Do I know you? Walk over and talk if you need something.
meet.opt.join: Care to group up for a bit?

meet.chat.city.default: Just restocking supplies and catching my breath in town.
meet.chat.city.homebody: I prefer staying inside city walls—it's dangerous out there.
meet.chat.city.chatty: Just wandering around! The Auction House is packed today.

meet.chat.town.default: Took a few jobs nearby—taking a breather before heading back out.
meet.chat.town.lazy: Nothing much. Just soaking up the sun.

meet.chat.field.default: Hunting out here to scrape together some coin.
meet.chat.field.diligent: Almost done clearing this area—moving on after a few more kills.

meet.join.yes.default: Sure, soloing's slow going anyway. Let's go.
meet.join.yes.chatty: Sounds great! Hunting alone was getting dull—lead the way!

meet.join.no.default: Thanks, but I've got my own business to tend to.
meet.join.no.lazy: Not really feeling up to it today. Maybe another time.
meet.join.no.homebody: Think I'll stay in town for now.

meet.join.toohigh.default: You're still a bit green for where I'm headed. Come back at level {level}.
meet.join.toohigh.chatty: Haha, you'd never keep up! Come find me once you hit level {level}.

meet.join.full: Looks like your hands are already full with that group.
meet.join.cannot: Just passing through—not looking to group up.

default: Careful, it's not safe around here.
chatty: Ouch, that looked bad. Up you go, and don't take them all on alone next time!
Just passing by. Your lucky day.
Have one on me, no need to thank me!
You look like you've come a long way. Take a blessing.

default: Apologies, that one was already mine.
chatty: Oops, stole your kill, sorry! The next one's yours.
By the Light, {thing}! Where did you get it?
When I grow up I want {thing} too!
{thing} looks amazing! Carry me some time?

admire.thing.head: that helm

trial.start.default: Just so we're clear, I'm only tagging along for a bit to see how we work together.
trial.start.chatty: Deal! Let's see how we mesh—if it goes well, I might just stick around!

trial.offer.default: {leader}, we make a pretty good team.
trial.offer.chatty: {leader}! Fighting alongside you has been a blast!

trial.offer.page.default: We've worked well together. What do you say... mind if I stick with you for good?
trial.offer.page.chatty: I've been thinking—adventuring alone isn't half as good as running with you. Keep me around?
trial.offer.page.quiet: ...Mind if I stay with you from now on?

trial.bond.later: Alright, just let me know whenever you decide.

trial.intro.default: Properly then: I'm {name}, a {class}. Looking forward to traveling with you, {leader}.
trial.intro.chatty: Proper introductions! I'm {name}, {class}—hit hard, eat plenty, talk a bit too much. Good to be with you, {leader}!
trial.intro.frugal: I'm {name}, a {class}. I'll manage my own coin and won't be a burden. Glad to travel with you, {leader}.

first.hello: Hey! Hold up—you just reporting in too?
first.why: {giver} says the roads have been rough lately, and newcomers shouldn't travel alone. I've been asking around, but no one's taken me up yet...
first.offer: I'm {name}, a {class}. How about we watch each other's backs? You take the lead, and I'll {help}.
first.opt.no: I'd rather go it alone for now.
first.yes: Awesome! Good to have a partner out here!
first.no: Alright... I'll be around here if you change your mind.
trait.nightowl.text: Rests and recovers faster at night.
trait.earlybird.text: Rests and recovers faster during the day.
trait.rainlover.text: Recovers faster in rain or snow.
trait.frugal.text: Pays less for repairs and squeezes a few extra copper from junk.
trait.thrifty.text: Gets better prices on food, ammo, and reagents.
trait.hardworker.text: Earns more coin while away from you.
trait.swimmer.text: Holds breath longer and swims faster.
trait.crafty.text: Sometimes crafts an extra item on multi-item recipes.
trait.saver.text: Sometimes saves the cheapest reagent when crafting.
trait.gatherer.text: Sometimes yields extra herbs, ore, or leather.
trait.pickup.text: Sometimes finds extra odds and ends when looting.
trait.scrounger.text: Gets a slightly larger share of looted coin.
trait.wanderer.text: Sends expedition parcels more often when away.
trait.quiet.text: Wild creatures are less likely to notice them.
trait.sharpeye.text: More likely to spot rare gems while gathering.
trait.swift.text: Arrives much faster when called, and crosses water without waiting for a ship.
trait.veteran.text: Sometimes sends usable gear in expedition parcels.
trait.thickskin.text: Takes slightly less damage from critical hits.
trait.revive.text: Rises in better shape after being resurrected.
trait.poisonres.text: Poisons and diseases wear off sooner.
trait.sturdy.text: A bit tougher with more health.
trait.steady.text: Less spell pushback when hit while casting.
trait.surefoot.text: Shrugs off slows and roots sooner.
trait.laststand.text: Sometimes clings on when brought to the brink.
trait.breather.text: Recovers rapidly right after combat ends.
trait.selfcare.text: Potions and bandages work better on them.
trait.tough.text: Higher resistance across all magic schools.
trait.composed.text: Breaks free from crowd control sooner.
trait.desperate.text: Takes less damage when low on health.
trait.backtowall.text: Holds the line harder when an ally falls.
trait.wary.text: Better at avoiding blows when surrounded.
trait.rooted.text: Harder to bring down while standing ground.
trait.dodgy.text: Takes less damage from area attacks.
trait.guard.text: Occasionally deflects part of a heavy blow.
trait.counter.text: Raises guard briefly after taking a critical hit.
trait.grit.text: Receives stronger healing when low on health.
gather.no_shards: Out of Soul Shards—{count} still left behind.
soulstone.unlearned: I haven't learned Create Soulstone yet—{name} doesn't have one.
soulstone.noshard: Out of Soul Shards—can't make a Soulstone for {name}.
soulstone.cooldown: Soulstone isn't ready yet—about {minutes} min left for {name}.
soulstone.cooldown.unknown: Soulstone isn't ready yet—can't give one to {name} right now.
popbot.noslot: Your group's looking pretty crowded already—I'll pass.
You've got plenty of hands already; maybe another time.
Too many in your company right now—next time.
popbot.farewell: We've already said our goodbyes. Safe travels.
We agreed to walk separate paths. Wish you well.
craft.mail.subject: Crafted Goods
mirror.intro: Your companion's task: only their own kills and pickups count. Bring them along.$B$B
mirror.placeholder.intro: Your companion hasn't picked up this quest yet. Bring them to {giver}; once they accept it, the full details will appear here.$B$B
artisan.quest.title: Artisan {skill}
artisan.quest.objective: Bring your companion to an Artisan {skill} trainer
